# Chinku — evidence (generated by `python -m eval.report` — do not edit)

Generated Sun 22 Nov 2026, 00:52 IST · brain model `gpt-5.5` (same model for Chinku and every baseline)

## 1. Exact transcription (photo → text)

13 pages with typed ground truth (252 words). **SIMULATED inputs:** handwriting-style fonts with rotation, blur and paper noise (Telugu pages drawn by Chrome for correct letter joining) — not real handwriting yet.
Baseline = the same model with one plain prompt: *"Read this image."*

| | Chinku (`transcribe_image`) | Baseline |
|---|---|---|
| Word error rate (all pages) | **0.8%** (2 errors) | 17.5% (44 errors) |
| Pages copied exactly (0 errors) | **12/13** | 9/13 |
| Words added that are not on the page | **2** | 36 |
| Telugu pages: errors | 2 | 40 |

How to read this: most baseline errors are **added text** ("The image reads:", an English translation of Telugu pages, markdown bullets) rather than misread words — still wrong for an exact copy that is emailed to someone. Chinku's remaining errors are on the Telugu note: it changed a word (మాత్ర → మాత్రం) and "corrected" a spelling (మర్చిపోవద్దు → మరిచిపోవద్దు), which its rules forbid — a known limit.

## 2. Planning (request → steps)

22 requests (English, Telugu, Hindi, Telugu-English mix; single and multi-step) through the real planner. Run 2026-11-22T00:50+05:30.

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Correct steps, in order | **22/22 (100%)** |
| Correct key fields (recipient, time, language, category, priority…) | **22/22 (100%)** |
| **Wrong-action rate** (a plan that emails / calls / adds to cart without being asked) | **0/22 (0%)** (target 0) |

Caveat: the requests were written by the builder and the planner instructions were tuned on similar wording — this is not a fresh hold-out set. Independently of the plan, code enforces approval before any email, call, cart change or reminder call.

## 3. Call extraction (phone call → facts with evidence)

12 calls (5 real, 7 scripted) · baseline = *"Summarise this call and list the price and details."* (from `eval/run_eval.py`).

| | Chinku | Baseline |
|---|---|---|
| Field accuracy | 43/44 (98%) | 44/44 (100%) |
| **Wrong-confirmed** (vague / refused / unstated reported as firm fact) | **0/11 (0%)** | 1/11 (9%) |

Honest result: no accuracy win on field values; the gain is in not reporting tentative answers as confirmed. Money is computed in code (e.g. dealer ₹714/bag × 50 = ₹35,700).

## 4. Persistence (restart mid-task)

Live server, 2026-11-22T00:51+05:30: a pending email approval was created, the server process was restarted (back in 3.2 s). Pending approval after restart: **yes — same task** (`i_2d26bac4`). The test then answered "no", so nothing was sent.
